messages:
lina_release: Quick heads-up 10m before the micro-cutover. Plan: pause writes, warm KV cache, pin runtime+router to v2.4.3-canary at 3% for 8m, run smoke checks, then 15% if stable. Adding a short rollback window (10m) after ramp. Thoughts?

tom_runtime: Suggest we set router.eviction-protection=true during the drain window. Last time a shard rebalance caused p95 blips. Also we should keep pooling backoff disabled temporarily.

jana_console: I'll mute noisy alerts and add a small UI status chip: "staged canary". Also posting quick-repro steps for support.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Preflight OK. Images available: runtime:v2.4.3-canary, router:v2.4.3-canary. Phase=PREP. Confirm action with `/deploy start 8421367000 --meta micro-cutover`

al_sre: Watching infra. If node_pressure OR kube_evictions >0 trigger immediate cutback. SLOs: p50 <250ms, error_rate <0.5%. If breached >90s, rollback.

vic_api: Verified no breaking header or auth changes. We should be safe for header-split after 15% stage.

lina_release: OK enabling eviction-protection and keeping pooling-backoff=off. Rollback pin set to v2.4.2-stable. Rollback triggers: sustained error >1% for 2m or p95 >750ms.

tom_runtime: Starting quiesce now. Commands:```bash
kubectl -n runtime scale deployment/ingest-workers --replicas=0
kubectl label pods -l app=router canary-protect=true --overwrite
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary kickoff requested by @lina_release. Routing 3% to canary. Monitoring: traces, p50/p95, error rate, eviction events. Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/8421367000

al_sre: Noting baseline metrics. No evictions. Router-canary nodes CPU + small, memory normal.

jana_console: Banner: "Staged Canary: runtime/router v2.4.3-canary (3%)" posted. Alerts muted for expected noise.

vic_api: We'll hold the header-split toggle until you confirm 15% ramp.

lina_release: Hold for 8m canary then decide. If green at +6m we'll ramp to 15% with automated checks. If any trigger hit, @tom_runtime will run `/deploy rollback 8421367000 --pin runtime,router=v2.4.2-stable` and SRE will cut traffic.

tom_runtime: Copy. Logs/traces streaming.

al_sre: At +4m still green. Small uptick in p95 but below threshold. No node events.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary stable at +5m. Automated health checks passed. Preparing ramp to 15% in 60s unless manual abort.

jana_console: FYI posted changelog link and short note to #product-release.

lina_release: Ramping to 15% now. Keep eyes on p95 and error windows.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Ramp complete  routing 15% to runtime/router v2.4.3-canary. Canary health hooks continuing.

al_sre: Seeing a small spike in router p95 at +2m after ramp, trending back down. No errors. Standby.

vic_api: Header-split toggle cleared to go after 10m steady at 15%.

lina_release: Thanks all. If steady for the rollback window, we'll unpin and promote canary to stable tag and update release notes. If not, we'll rollback to v2.4.2-stable.
